hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: EulerSwap is a Uniswap v4 hook implementing a custom AMM curve using Euler vault-backed liquidity. Swaps execute entirely within `beforeSwap`: input tokens are deposited into Euler vaults, output tokens withdrawn, and a custom curve invariant verified — bypassing Uniswap's CLAMM via `beforeSwapReturnsDelta`. Standard liquidity positions and donations are intentionally blocked.
